Friendzy / Classic party games / Character Swap

How to play Character Swap

You're mid-scene. Your character just changed. Two players act out a scene. At any moment, anyone watching can shout a new character type — the actor must instantly become that character while continuing the scene.

3–10 players~10 minChaotic & CreativeActing & performance games

How to play

  1. Two players begin a scene — host gives them a starting scenario.
  2. Watchers can shout any character name at any time.
  3. The actor being called must immediately become that character — same scene, new person.
  4. Example: 'Shakespeare!' → actor must speak in verse. 'Toddler!' → scene continues with a toddler.
  5. Keep swapping rapidly for maximum chaos.

Example round

  • Scene: two people arguing about dishes. Swap: 'Pirate!' → 'Yar, thou shalt do the dishes, landlubber!'
  • Swap: 'News anchor!' → scene continues as a live broadcast of the dish argument.
  • Rapid swaps every 10 seconds: chef → ninja → grandma → robot. Impossible. Hilarious.

Tips

  • The more specific the character, the better: 'disappointed dad' vs just 'dad'.
  • Keep the original scenario — don't let the scene drift.
